faizal: Heads up — Prod support ticket: customer hit a tenant quota on a dedicated embeddings route and got a 500. They expected 429.
kelly: ugh. can you paste the raw response + headers?
faizal: ```http
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route-Name: embeddings-dedicated-7
X-Decision: quota_check_late
X-Internal-Error: shard_timeout

{ \"error\": \"shard_timeout\" }
```
rachel: This is the late-quota problem. Gateway only rewrites to 429 when it blocks at ingress. If the route enforces quota post-forward we leak infra 5xx to customers.
tony: We discussed simple header mapping before but I want to push for two things: 1) a machine-friendly numeric client-facing subcode header (e.g. `X-Client-Code: 429.1001`) so integrators can switch on exact reasons, and 2) a human header `X-Client-Status: quota_exceeded` for readability.
kelly: Agree on both. Numeric subcodes let SDKs map behavior without brittle string matching. Proposed subcode scheme: 429.1000 = tenant_quota, 429.1001 = route_quota, 429.2000 = model_rate_limit, 500.3000 = infra_shard_timeout, etc.
faizal: Nice. For streaming responses we can't change HTTP status mid-flight. Proposal: emit a final JSON control event: `{\"event\":\"terminal\",\"client_code\":\"429.1000\",\"reason\":\"tenant_quota\"}` then close stream. SDKs should inspect final event.
rachel: Telemetry asks: add `client_code` label to the existing `response_total` metric and a new derived ratio `quota_misattribution_ratio = sum(response_total{code=~\"5..\",client_code=~\"^429.*\"}) / sum(response_total{code=~\"5..\"})`. Dashboard tile should show percent of 5xx that are actually client quota so SREs can spot misattribution.
tony: Console UX: add a \"Failure Insights\" card on the Route details page that surfaces top client codes (numeric) for the route, a time-series of quota vs infra errors, and a single-click \"request quota increase\" CTA when quota is dominant. Keep copy: \"This route is impacted by tenant quota hits. Request increases or view usage.\"
kelly: Rollout plan: feature flag `client_code_enrichment`. Canary 15% for 24h. Monitors: 1) expected rise in 429.* signals in analytics, 2) no uptick in true infra 5xx rates, 3) stream terminal event errors in client telemetry. Add alert if stream terminal events > 0.5% of traffic to avoid breaking clients.
\faizal: Tests: add an integration test in the staging harness that simulates deferred quota at the route, asserts gateway emits 429 and headers for non-streamed flows, and for streaming asserts final terminal event present with `client_code`.
\rachel: Also ensure logs include both `client_code` and `internal_cause` structured fields. That way SREs can query: `internal_cause=shard_timeout AND client_code=429.1000` to find cases where quota was misattributed.
kelly: SDK guidance: update error handling docs: precedence: 1) prefer `X-Client-Code` numeric mapping, 2) fallback to `X-Client-Status` string, 3) if neither present, fall back to HTTP status. Example snippet included for python/js showing how to handle stream terminal object.
tony: Ownership: I'll take gateway mapping + subcode registry doc. @rachel will add telemetry and dashboard mocks, @kelly will update SDK docs, @faizal will add tests and customer follow-up note.
\infra-bot: deploy triggered: feat/client-code-enrich -> gateway-canary (15%)
\faizal: I'll monitor canary and will create a short rollback playbook if we see unexpected client-side failures. Schedule 30m sync if alerts fire.
kelly: one nit: ensure header names are stable (no renames after rollout) — put them in the public changelog.
rachel: ACK. I'll draft the dashboard tile and copy.
tony: PR opened in #pull-requests. Tests and registry are attached.
faizal: thanks team — let's keep PR comments focused on subcode naming and stream format.
